response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong track record in web, backend, and low-latency systems, but the profile does not align with the core requirements of this role. Hands-on C++ experience appears limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 (plus a university thesis project), far short of the required 5–10 years of production C++ on Windows. There is no evidence of fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure, and SQL experience is generic (MySQL/MongoDB) with no SQL Server or Oracle. Recent work is predominantly TypeScript/Node.js and DLang on Linux/cloud stacks. Strong fundamentals and communication skills are evident, but the mandatory technical and domain criteria are not met.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience with low-latency, high-throughput systems (DLang, async I/O, fibers)
Strong software craftsmanship practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development, DevOps tooling
Excellent communication demonstrated through conference talks, workshops, and course authoring
concerns: C++ experience is roughly six months and over a decade old; no Windows-platform C++ track record
No fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
SQL experience is generic (MySQL/MongoDB); no SQL Server or Oracle exposure

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
No SQL Server / Oracle or Windows platform depth
